entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `content` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourceInfo` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `content` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`library_entries`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_library_entries_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `library_entries` BEGIN DELETE FROM `library_entries_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_library_entries_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `library_entries` BEGIN DELETE FROM `library_entries_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_library_entries_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `library_entries` BEGIN INSERT INTO `library_entries_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `content`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`content`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_library_entries_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `library_entries` BEGIN INSERT INTO `library_entries_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `content`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`content`); END
